messages:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — going to ship a tiny hotfix: bump 2.3.4 -> 2.3.5 to include a null-cache header guard. Planning cutoff at 16:00 UTC today. Can folks give :thumbsup: if green, or call out any blocking test flakes? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4231
Ravi: Quick glance — LGTM, left a nit about the test name in the PR comments. Not blocking :+1:
Sasha: Changelog blurb added in the PR, kept it minimal. Also added manual smoke test steps.
Morgan: Which branch are we cutting from? main or release/2.3? If release branch, I can handle the cherry-pick.
Jamie: Cutting from release/2.3. Morgan — please do the cherry-pick and tag, then ping me to kick off the canary.
Morgan: On it. Will run `git checkout release/2.3 && git cherry-pick 1a2b3c4 && git push --follow-tags` and open a follow-up PR for the tag.
CI-bot: build #4231 passed — unit and integration — 5 mins ago
Ravi: One more thing — the telemetry change requires a migration flag toggled on; added `--enable-null-cache-guard` to deploy plan.
Jamie: Noted. We'll keep flag off by default and enable during canary.
Sasha: Canary plan: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if no regressions. I added the sheets link for smoke checklist: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example
Jamie: Sweet. If no objections I'll cut at 16:00 UTC. Otherwise speak up now.
Ravi: No objections from me.
Morgan: PR merged and tag pushed: v2.3.5
Jamie: Thanks — kicking off canary. I'll post updates in #incidents if anything pops.
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Sasha: :tada:
